daily_messages.title: God Is With You
daily_messages.message: Fear not, for I am with you. Be not dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, yes, I will help you.

daily_messages.title: His Mercies Are New
daily_messages.message: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because His compassions fail not. They are new every morning.

daily_messages.title: Trust His Plan
daily_messages.message: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

daily_messages.title: Cast Your Cares
daily_messages.message: Casting all your care upon Him, for He careth for you.

daily_messages.title: Strength for Today
daily_messages.message: They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.

daily_messages.title: Pastors' Appreciation Sunday
daily_messages.message: Don't forget! October 25th is our Pastors' Appreciation Sunday. Let's honor our shepherds.

daily_messages.title: Missions Month Coming
daily_messages.message: November is Missions Month. Plan to be part of the Great Commission. Pray, give, and go!

daily_messages.title: You Are Loved
daily_messages.message: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish.

daily_messages.title: Perfect Peace
daily_messages.message: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on Thee: because he trusteth in Thee.

daily_messages.title: More Than Conquerors
daily_messages.message: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him that loved us.

daily_messages.title: Annual Thanksgiving
daily_messages.message: Save the date! December 13th is our Annual Thanksgiving service. Come with your testimony!

daily_messages.title: He Is Faithful
daily_messages.message: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; for He is faithful that promised.
